files.label: file(name) gives the last file of a name, null for a name with only a value or without a part, and files() pairs each name with its files in request order (HY-113.2)
files.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="a.txt"

first
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="t"

text
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="g"; filename="g.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

third
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="b.txt"

second
--XyZ--

files.label: a file with an empty filename is the file of its name (HY-113.4)
names of digits are names: the pairs keep the order of the first file of each name (HY-113.2)
files.body:
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="1"; filename="one.txt"

1
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="0"; filename="zero.txt"

0
--XyZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="1"; filename="uno.txt"

u
--XyZ--
